psygun.label: Psygun
psygun.line: A face of 4 or less. Deals its face + 2. Twice a round.

lockheart.label: Lockheart
lockheart.line: An even face. Guards that much of the foe's blow.

dreamvane.label: Dreamvane
dreamvane.line: A face of 2 or more. Splits it into two dice.

crucibelle.label: Crucibelle
crucibelle.line: Any dice. Counts down from 12 across rounds; at 0 the foe's blow is stopped.
